column1: Table S1. Structure and description of the epibenthic invertebrate dataset collected during the 2022 European Union Flemish Cap bottom-trawl survey. Trawl identifies the sampling haul; Lowest_Taxon indicates the lowest taxonomic level to which the organism was identified; Number represents the number of individuals recorded; and Weight represents the total wet weight (g). For colonial taxa, abundance was recorded as one colony per record (number = 1), and Weight corresponds to the wet weight of the entire colony.
